headline: China Reports Export Surge
what: China said September exports increased 36.3% from a year earlier, while imports advanced 31%.
context: Its trade surplus reached $133.5 billion for the month and $938 billion through September.
why_it_matters: Stronger Chinese trade can signal overseas demand and affect U.S. manufacturers, shipping companies, and commodity prices.

headline: IEA Cuts Oil Demand Outlook
what: The International Energy Agency expects world oil demand to decline by 2.6 million barrels a day this year.
context: It expects only a partial recovery next year as high prices weaken consumption and disrupt supply.
why_it_matters: The balance between lower demand and constrained supply can steer fuel prices, inflation, and transportation costs.

headline: Strike Damages Aramco Offices
what: A Houthi strike damaged upper floors at Saudi Aramco's headquarters, including the chief executive's office. No casualties were reported.
context: The incident extended the regional conflict to the offices of the world's largest oil exporter.
why_it_matters: Escalation around Saudi energy infrastructure can raise concern about oil supply, shipping, and global fuel costs.
